text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a deploy wave for Thu 2026-05-14 (UTC). Need canary + smoke owners and rollback leads for these stacks: inference-api, router, redis-cache, console-ui. Proposed windows: 09:00-09:30 UTC canaries, 09:30-10:30 UTC ramp. Please call dibs and confirm rollback readiness. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/prod/deploy-runbook :wave:

sana: I can take inference-api canary + run the smoke checklist. Will be available 08:45-10:15 UTC. :thumbsup:

chris: I'll pick router canary. I'll do the initial traffic split and monitor edge 200s/latency.

maggie: I'll own redis-cache rollback readiness and standby during the ramp. I have the fallback image + snapshot restore steps ready.

tim: console-ui small deploy — I can push at 09:45 and run quick UI smoke (login, main route).

alex: awesome. Sana, add the migration note for inference-api. If there are DB migrations do them in canary with `--plan-only` first then run. Add a short prereq checklist: deploy manifest validated, healthcheck endpoints respond, perf <200ms p50, error rate <0.5% during canary.

sana: quick Q — inference-api has a minor schema change that is backwards compatible. Plan: run migrate in canary with feature-flag off, then enable after canary looks good. Is that ok?

alex: yes. Run migration against canary DB replica, validate with a small prompt set. Keep migrate window <5m. If anything looks off abort and rollback.

chris: noted. I'll do traffic split 5% -> 25% -> 50% over the 30m window unless we see regression. I'll post metrics snapshots at each step.

maggie: rollback details I uploaded: https://wiki.redwood/prod/rollback/redis-cache (includes snapshot IDs and `restore_snapshot.sh`). Backup snapshot ID: snap-20260513-03.

alex: copy. Devops-bot, can you create the wave schedule and tag owners?

devops-bot: Created schedule: `deploy-wave-1980000000`. Slots: inference-api(09:00) owner@sana, router(09:05) owner@chris, redis-cache(09:15) owner@maggie, console-ui(09:45) owner@tim. Release board: https://boards.redwood/releases/wave-1980000000

tim: a tiny deploy note — console-ui depends on `cdn-config` which is already warmed. I'll run `invalidate --fast` after deploy.

sana: smoke commands below — will run these in canary after container rollout:
```bash
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/inference-api
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://inference.prod/health | jq .
# run a small inference test set (10 prompts) and verify latency/error budget
```

alex: perfect. Checklist for everyone before morning: update release board with exact image tags, paste smoke commands, and confirm rollback artifacts (image tag, DB snapshot, restore steps). If no objections I'll mark wave green by 08:00 UTC tomorrow.

sana: added image tags and smoke scripts to the board.

chris: posted traffic plan + dashboard links.

maggie: rollback scripts and snapshot posted.

tim: console UI tag pushed and CDN ready.

alex: thanks all. If anything unexpected comes up ping here or call the on-call. Otherwise we'll proceed as scheduled. :white_check_mark:

tim: ack :white_check_mark:
